headline: Video: Bos BI Bahas Gejolak Global,BI Rate dan Rupiah di 2 Tahun Prabowo
summary: Bank Indonesia's governor addressed global turbulence, a rise in the BI Rate and the rupiah's performance in the two years of the Prabowo administration. The discussion was presented in a video briefing.
why: Bank Indonesia sets the country's benchmark interest rate and manages the rupiah, which together drive borrowing costs and foreign investor flows.
